legal.wedoTheAppIsAPrivateSpaceForSaving: WeDo (the "App") is a private space for saving ideas, making plans and deciding together. WeDo is not a public social network. We take the privacy and protection of your personal information seriously.
legal.weCollectTheFollowingInformationWh: We collect the following information when you use the app:
legal.yourEmailAddressDisplayNameAndForP: Your email address, display name and, for password-based accounts, a password hash. When you sign up with email, we send a time-limited verification code. A secure digest of the code and attempt information are stored on the server.
legal.whenYouSignInWithAppleWeReceiveAnO: When you sign in with Apple, we receive an opaque user identifier and, depending on your choices, your name and email address. We securely store an encrypted Apple refresh token to manage and revoke this connection. Apple account-change notifications update your sign-in and email forwarding status. If revocation temporarily fails after account deletion, the encrypted token is retained until revocation succeeds.
legal.yourGoogleUserIdentifierVerifiedEm: Your Google user identifier, verified email address and profile name are used to create your account and verify sign-ins. We do not receive your Google password or request access to Gmail, Drive or Calendar.
legal.theEmailAddressAndDescriptionYouSu: The email address and description you submit are sent to our support inbox to assess your request and verify account ownership.
legal.linksNotesListsVotesAndMemoryPhoto: Links, notes, lists, votes and memory photos you add to shared spaces.
legal.pushNotificationTokensUsedToNotify: Push notification tokens used to notify you of activity in your shared space.
legal.theAppRequestsAccessToYourCameraAn: The app requests access to your camera and photo library so you can add photos to shared memories or saved items. These permissions are used only when you choose to add content; we do not automatically scan your library in the background.
legal.wedoDoesNotSellOrRentPersonalInfor: WeDo does not sell or rent personal information to advertisers or data brokers. Shared content is visible to the space members you invite. Google or Apple provides authentication when you choose that sign-in method. Web support requests, including your email and description, are sent through Resend to our Google Workspace support inbox.
legal.youCanDeleteYourAccountAndAssociat: You can delete your account and associated personal data in the app under Settings > Delete account. Passwordless accounts do not need to provide a password. Confirming deletion revokes your active sessions and removes your sign-in identities. Shared content may remain attributed to an anonymised account.
legal.forQuestionsRequestsOrFeedbackAbou: For questions, requests or feedback about this privacy policy, contact us at
legal.byDownloadingWedoCreatingAnAccount: By downloading WeDo, creating an account or using the app, you agree to these Terms of Service and End User Licence Agreement (EULA). If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

legal.reportedContentIsReviewedWithin24H: . Reported content is reviewed within 24 hours. Objectionable content is removed, and accounts that violate the rules may be suspended or permanently terminated.
legal.youAreResponsibleForKeepingYourAcc: You are responsible for keeping your account secure. You may close your account at any time under Settings > Delete account. We may suspend or remove accounts that violate these terms without prior notice.
